meta.title: Egyptian Food, Healthier
meta.disclaimer: This information is for education and awareness only and is not a substitute for advice from a dietitian or doctor, especially for people with chronic conditions.

dishes.name: Koshary

steps: Boil the lentils, then add the rice and cook both until done.
Boil the pasta in salted water.
Deep-fry the onions in plenty of oil until crispy.
Make the sauce by frying garlic in oil, then adding tomatoes, vinegar and cumin.
Serve the rice, lentils, pasta and chickpeas topped with the sauce and fried onions.

ingredients: Vinegar, cumin, a little salt and chili
steps: Soak the brown rice for an hour, then cook it with the lentils until done.
Boil the whole-wheat pasta in lightly salted water.
Cook the onions in the oven or air fryer with a light oil spray until golden and crisp.
Make the sauce with 1 tbsp olive oil, fresh tomatoes, garlic and cumin.
Serve with extra chickpeas, more sauce and less fried topping.

what_changed: Brown rice and whole-wheat pasta have more fiber and keep you full longer
Oven-cooked onions instead of deep-frying cut fat a lot
Less salt and less hot sauce
tips: Add more chickpeas and lentils for plant protein
Serve with a vegetable salad on the side

dishes.name: Chicken Molokhia

steps: Boil the chicken with onion, salt and spices and keep the broth.
Heat the broth and add the molokhia.
Fry the garlic and coriander in ghee and stir it in (the taqliya).
Serve with chicken browned in the oven or ghee and white rice.

ingredients: Brown rice or freekeh to serve
steps: Boil the skinless chicken with onion and spices, then skim the fat off the broth.
Heat the broth and add the molokhia.
Fry the garlic and coriander in just 1 tsp olive oil and stir it in.
Grill or air-fry the chicken instead of frying and serve with brown rice.

what_changed: Removing the skin and skimming the broth reduces saturated fat
A little olive oil instead of ghee
Brown rice instead of white
tips: Molokhia itself is rich in fiber, so enjoy a generous portion
Go easy on salt because the broth already has some

dishes.name: Stuffed Cabbage

ingredients: Garlic, oil and ghee for the taqliya
steps: Blanch the cabbage leaves until soft.
Mix the rice with the herbs, onion, tomato and spices.
Fill and roll the leaves.
Pack them in a pot over a layer of ghee and fried garlic and cover with water.
Simmer gently until cooked.

ingredients: 1 cup soaked brown rice mixed with 1/2 cup bulgur
A little salt, pepper and cumin
steps: Blanch the cabbage leaves until soft.
Mix the soaked rice and bulgur with plenty of herbs, onion, tomato and spices.
Fill the leaves with a smaller amount of filling and roll.
Pack them in a pot with garlic and olive oil and cover with water.
Simmer gently until cooked.

what_changed: Brown rice and bulgur instead of only white rice
A herb-heavy filling means more fiber and vitamins
Olive oil instead of ghee
tips: Serve with plain yogurt
Use vegetable stock instead of stock cubes

dishes.name: Stuffed Grape Leaves

steps: Soak the leaves in hot water and drain.
Mix the rice with the herbs, onion, tomato and spices.
Fill and roll the leaves.
Pack in a pot with tomato slices and ghee, then cover with water and lemon juice.
Simmer gently until cooked.

ingredients: A large amount of dill, parsley and mint
A little salt, pepper and cumin
steps: Rinse the leaves well to remove extra salt.
Mix the rice and bulgur with plenty of herbs, onion, tomato and spices.
Fill the leaves lightly and roll.
Pack in a pot with tomato slices, olive oil, lemon and water.
Simmer gently until cooked.

what_changed: Rinsing the leaves well reduces excess salt
Bulgur and brown rice add fiber
A spoon of olive oil instead of ghee
tips: Lemon adds flavor so you need less salt
Enjoy a reasonable number of pieces with a salad

dishes.name: Stuffed Zucchini & Eggplant

steps: Core the zucchini and eggplant.
Mix the rice with the herbs, onion, tomato and spices.
Stuff the vegetables.
Pack in a pot with sauce, ghee and water.
Cook until done.

ingredients: Onion, tomato and plenty of herbs
steps: Core the vegetables and brush the eggplant with a light oil spray instead of frying it.
Mix the rice and bulgur with plenty of herbs, onion, tomato and spices.
Stuff the vegetables loosely.
Arrange in a tray with fresh tomato sauce and water.
Cover and bake in the oven until cooked.

what_changed: Baking instead of frying and cooking in ghee
Fresh tomato sauce instead of ready-made
More fiber from bulgur and brown rice
tips: Add the scooped-out zucchini flesh to the filling instead of throwing it away
Serve with yogurt

dishes.name: Fatta

steps: Toast the bread in ghee or the oven.
Place it in a dish and top with rice.
Moisten with the rich meat broth.
Fry garlic in ghee and add the vinegar and tomato.
Pour the sauce and the meat pieces over the top.

ingredients: Whole-wheat baladi bread, toasted in the oven
steps: Tear the whole-wheat bread and toast it in the oven without ghee.
Place it in a dish and top with brown rice.
Moisten with the meat broth after removing the fat from the surface.
Fry the garlic in 1 tbsp olive oil and add the vinegar and tomato.
Pour the sauce and the lean meat pieces over the top.

what_changed: Oven-toasted whole-wheat bread instead of frying in ghee
Fat removed from the broth
Less meat and more vegetables
tips: Serve with a big salad
Skinless chicken can replace the meat

dishes.name: Creamy Baked Rice (Roz Mo'ammar)

steps: Rinse the rice and put it in a clay dish.
Add the milk, cream, salt and butter.
Bake at high heat, then lower the heat.
Leave until it dries and forms a golden top.
Soak the brown rice for an hour, drain and put it in a clay dish.
Add the low-fat milk, yogurt and salt.
Cover and bake at medium heat.
Cook until the rice is tender, the liquid is absorbed and the top is golden.

what_changed: Low-fat milk instead of whole milk
Light cream or yogurt instead of cream
Brown rice and less butter
tips: Serve as a small side dish
Grilled chicken pieces go well with it

dishes.name: Roasted Chicken with Freekeh

steps: Season the chicken with spices and salt and rub with ghee.
Roast until browned.
Cook the freekeh with onion in ghee.
Serve the chicken over the freekeh.

ingredients: Lemon, garlic, spices and a little salt
steps: Marinate the skinless chicken with lemon, garlic and spices.
Roast covered in the oven, then uncover to brown.
Cook the freekeh with onion browned in 1 tbsp olive oil.
Serve the chicken over the freekeh with a few almonds and a salad.

what_changed: Skinless and roasted instead of fried in ghee
Freekeh is a good source of fiber and protein
Lemon-and-garlic marinade instead of lots of salt
tips: Avoid ready-made stock cubes
Best served with roasted vegetables

dishes.name: Fried Fish

steps: Clean the fish and season with salt and cumin.
Dredge in flour.
Deep-fry in plenty of oil.
Serve with lemon.
Clean the fish and marinate with garlic, cumin, coriander, lemon and olive oil.
Leave for 30 minutes.
Place in a tray with the tomatoes and peppers.
Bake in the oven or air fryer until cooked.
Serve with lemon and a salad.

what_changed: Baking instead of deep-frying
No flour coating
Fish is a good source of omega-3 when it is not fried
tips: Aim for fish twice a week
Go easy on pickles with fish

dishes.name: Kofta Tagine with Tomato

steps: Mix the meat with onion, parsley and spices.
Shape into kofta and fry in oil.
Place in a tagine with tomatoes, sauce and ghee.
Bake until done.
Mix the lean meat with grated onion, parsley and spices.
Shape the kofta and place in a tagine without frying first.
Add the tomatoes, peppers, fresh tomato sauce and olive oil.
Bake covered, then uncovered, until cooked.

what_changed: Lean meat instead of fatty
No frying of the kofta
Fresh tomato sauce and more vegetables
tips: Add extra vegetables to the tagine
Serve with brown rice or a salad

dishes.name: Potato & Meat Tray

steps: Fry the potatoes in oil.
Brown the meat with the onion.
Layer the potatoes and meat in a tray.
Add the tomatoes and spices.
Bake in the oven.

ingredients: A little salt, pepper and cumin
steps: Toss the potatoes, carrots and zucchini in 1 tbsp olive oil.
Season the meat with onion and spices.
Layer the vegetables and meat in a tray.
Add the tomatoes and spices and cover with foil.
Bake, then uncover to brown.

what_changed: No frying of the potatoes
A variety of vegetables instead of potatoes alone
Leaner and smaller portion of meat
tips: Use fewer potatoes and more vegetables
Serve with a green salad

dishes.name: Moussaka

steps: Slice the eggplant and fry in plenty of oil.
Make a sauce from tomatoes, garlic and vinegar.
Add the eggplant and peppers to the sauce.
Cook until it comes together.
Slice the eggplant and lightly spray with olive oil.
Bake or air-fry until soft.
Make the tomato, garlic and vinegar sauce without extra oil.
Add the eggplant and peppers to the sauce and cook for a few minutes.

what_changed: Baking the eggplant instead of deep-frying
Eggplant soaks up a lot of oil when fried
A fresh tomato sauce
tips: Serve hot or cold
Enjoy with whole-wheat bread and a salad

dishes.name: Okra with Meat (Bamia)

steps: Brown the meat and onion in ghee.
Add water and cook until tender.
Fry the okra with garlic and coriander.
Add the sauce, then the meat and some broth.
Simmer until it comes together.
Boil the meat with the onion until tender and skim the fat from the broth.
Sauté the okra with garlic and coriander in 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add the fresh sauce and lemon juice, then the meat and a little broth.
Simmer gently until it comes together.

what_changed: Lean meat or chicken
Olive oil instead of ghee
Lemon prevents sliminess and adds flavor instead of salt
tips: Okra is rich in fiber
Serve with a small portion of brown rice

dishes.name: Peas & Carrots (Besella)

steps: Brown the onion and garlic in ghee.
Add the minced meat and stir.
Add the peas and carrots.
Add the sauce and water and cook until done.
Sauté the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add the lean meat and stir until it changes color.
Add the peas, carrots, fresh sauce and spices.
Cover and simmer until done.

what_changed: Olive oil instead of ghee
Less meat and less fat
Carrots and peas supply fiber and vitamins
tips: It can be made fully vegetarian
Serve with brown rice

dishes.name: Okawi Tagine (Slow-Cooked Beef)

steps: Brown the beef with the onion in ghee.
Add water and cook until tender.
Place in a tagine with tomatoes, garlic and ghee.
Bake until browned.

ingredients: A little salt, pepper and spices
steps: Boil the meat with onion and spices until tender and remove the fat.
Place in a tagine with tomatoes, garlic and olive oil.
Cover and bake at low heat.
Uncover for the last 10 minutes to brown.

what_changed: Boiling then baking instead of browning in ghee
Visible fat removed
Less meat and more vegetables
tips: Add vegetables like carrots and zucchini
Serve with a salad

dishes.name: Foul Medames

steps: Heat the foul.
Add oil or ghee.
Add cumin, salt and lemon.
Serve with baladi bread.
Heat the foul and drain some of the salty liquid.
Add 1 tsp olive oil, cumin and lemon.
Top with chopped tomato, onion and parsley.
Serve with whole-wheat bread and fresh vegetables.

what_changed: A little olive oil instead of lots of ghee or hot oil
More fresh vegetables
Whole-wheat bread instead of white
tips: Foul is a source of plant protein and fiber
Go easy on salt because canned foul is already salty

dishes.name: Ta'ameya (Egyptian Falafel)

steps: Soak the cracked fava beans.
Grind them with the herbs, onion and spices.
Shape into discs.
Deep-fry in plenty of oil.

ingredients: A large amount of onion, cilantro and parsley
A light spray of olive oil
steps: Grind the soaked beans with the herbs, garlic and spices.
Shape into small discs and sprinkle with sesame.
Place on a tray lightly sprayed with oil.
Bake or air-fry until golden and crisp on both sides.

what_changed: Baking or air-frying instead of deep-frying
More herbs in the mix
A light oil spray instead of submerging
tips: Serve in whole-wheat bread with salad and tahini
The air fryer gives a crunch close to frying

dishes.name: Eggs with Basterma

steps: Fry the basterma in ghee.
Crack the eggs over it.
Cook until set.

ingredients: A few drops of olive oil
steps: Sauté the tomato and green pepper in a non-stick pan with a few drops of olive oil.
Add a thin slice of basterma, cut small.
Crack the eggs on top and cover until set.
Serve with whole-wheat bread.

what_changed: Less basterma because it is high in salt and fat
Tomato and pepper instead of ghee
A non-stick pan to use less fat
tips: Boiled eggs are a lighter alternative
Do not add salt because basterma is already salty

dishes.name: Feteer Meshaltet

steps: Knead the flour with water and salt.
Let the dough rest.
Roll out, brush generously with ghee and fold repeatedly.
Bake in the oven.

ingredients: Half white flour, half whole-wheat flour
Cottage cheese or yogurt with a little honey
steps: Knead both flours with water, salt and olive oil.
Let the dough rest for 30 minutes.
Roll out thinly, brush with a very light layer of olive oil and fold.
Bake in a hot oven until golden.
Serve with cottage cheese and vegetables.

what_changed: Whole-wheat flour for more fiber
A little olive oil instead of lots of ghee
A healthier topping instead of lots of honey or sugar
tips: Make it an occasional meal rather than a daily one
Serve with fresh vegetables

dishes.name: Old Cheese with Tomato

steps: Cut the cheese.
Add the tomato and oil.
Heat in the oven or on the stove.

ingredients: Cottage cheese or low-salt white cheese
Mint or parsley and black pepper
steps: Cut the low-salt white cheese and soak it in water to reduce the salt.
Chop the tomato, cucumber and pepper.
Mix everything with olive oil and mint.
Let it sit 5 minutes to absorb the flavors and serve with whole-wheat bread.

what_changed: Aged cheese is high in salt and fat, so a low-salt cheese replaces it
Soaking the cheese reduces salt
More fresh vegetables
tips: Cottage cheese is light and rich in protein
Cut back on salt in breakfast overall

dishes.name: Fried Potatoes

steps: Cut the potatoes into sticks.
Deep-fry in plenty of oil.
Sprinkle with salt and serve.
Cut the potatoes into sticks, rinse and dry them.
Toss with olive oil and the spices.
Spread on a tray in a single layer.
Bake or air-fry until golden and crisp.

what_changed: Oven or air fryer instead of deep-frying
Herb seasoning instead of lots of salt
Sweet potato can add variety
tips: Serve a small portion as a side
Rinsing before baking removes surface starch and gives more crunch

dishes.name: Hawawshi

steps: Mix the meat with the onion, pepper, parsley and spices.
Stuff the bread with it.
Brush the bread with ghee.
Bake until browned.
Mix the lean meat with plenty of onion, pepper, parsley and spices.
Stuff the whole-wheat bread with a thin layer.
Lightly spray the top with olive oil.
Bake in the oven or air fryer until browned.
Serve with a salad.

what_changed: Whole-wheat bread instead of white
Lean meat and more vegetables in the filling
No ghee
tips: Have half a piece with a salad instead of a whole one
Minced chicken works too

dishes.name: Lentil Soup

steps: Brown the onion in ghee.
Add the lentils, carrot and water.
Cook until the lentils are soft.
Blend and add cumin.

ingredients: Onion, carrot and a small potato
steps: Sauté the onion in 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add the rinsed lentils, carrot, potato and water.
Cook until the lentils are completely soft.
Blend and add cumin, turmeric and lemon.

what_changed: Olive oil instead of ghee
More vegetables for extra fiber
Lemon and cumin instead of lots of salt
tips: Serve with toasted whole-wheat bread
Add spinach or chard if you like

dishes.name: Vegetable Soup

steps: Fry the vegetables in ghee.
Add water and a stock cube.
Cook until tender.
Sauté the onion and garlic in 1 tsp olive oil.
Add the vegetables, cut small.
Add low-salt homemade stock or water.
Cook until the vegetables are tender and add the parsley.

what_changed: Homemade stock instead of salty cubes
A little olive oil instead of ghee
A larger amount of vegetables
tips: Blend it for a creamy texture without cream
Serve it as a starter before the meal

dishes.name: Baladi Salad

steps: Dice the vegetables.
Add the vinegar, salt and oil.
Toss and serve.
Dice all the vegetables to a medium size.
Mix the lemon juice, olive oil and mint.
Toss the vegetables in the dressing just before serving.
Serve before the meal.

what_changed: Lemon and a little olive oil instead of lots of vinegar and oil
More variety of vegetables
Less salt
tips: Eating salad first helps you feel full
Add pomegranate or seeds for variety

dishes.name: Baba Ghanoush

steps: Roast the eggplant and peel it.
Mash it.
Add the tahini, garlic, lemon and oil.
Serve.
Roast the eggplant in the oven until soft and peel it.
Mash it and drain off excess liquid.
Add a small amount of tahini, the yogurt, garlic and lemon.
Serve with raw vegetables instead of white bread.

what_changed: Less tahini with yogurt for a light creamy texture
Oven-roasted eggplant without oil
Served with vegetables instead of bread
tips: Serve with carrot and cucumber sticks
Use it as a salad dressing instead of mayonnaise

dishes.name: Om Ali

steps: Bake and break up the pastry.
Layer it with the nuts.
Pour over the milk, sugar and cream.
Bake until browned.

ingredients: A small amount of raw nuts
steps: Toast the pastry or bread in the oven and break it up.
Layer it in a dish with a few nuts.
Heat the low-fat milk with the honey or mashed dates and cinnamon.
Pour it over the pastry.
Bake for 10 minutes until the top browns.

what_changed: Low-fat milk instead of whole milk and cream
A little honey or dates instead of sugar
A small amount of raw nuts
tips: Serve a small portion
Cinnamon adds sweetness without extra sugar

dishes.name: Konafa

steps: Shred the konafa and coat it with plenty of ghee.
Spread half in a tray.
Add the filling.
Cover with the rest and bake.
Pour over the heavy syrup.

ingredients: 2 tbsp melted butter or olive oil
Greek yogurt and cottage cheese filling
Light honey or a very light syrup
steps: Shred the konafa and toss with a very small amount of melted butter.
Spread half in a tray.
Add the yogurt and cottage cheese filling.
Cover with the rest and bake until golden.
Drizzle with a little light syrup and pistachios.

what_changed: Far less fat in the pastry
A yogurt and cottage cheese filling instead of cream
A light syrup instead of heavy
tips: Have it as a small piece, not every day
Fresh fruit goes well with it

dishes.name: Basbousa

steps: Mix the semolina, sugar, ghee and yogurt.
Let it rest.
Pour into a tray and top with almonds.
Bake, then pour over the syrup.

ingredients: A little mashed dates or honey
steps: Mix the semolina and flour with the yogurt and olive oil.
Add the mashed dates as a sweetener.
Let it rest for 30 minutes.
Pour into a tray and top with almonds.
Bake until golden and drizzle with a little diluted honey.

what_changed: Whole-wheat flour for more fiber
Dates or honey in a smaller amount instead of sugar and heavy syrup
Olive oil instead of ghee
tips: Cut it into small pieces
Enjoy with unsweetened tea

dishes.name: Rice Pudding (Roz bel Laban)

steps: Boil the rice.
Add the milk and simmer.
Add the sugar, starch and vanilla.
Cook until it thickens.
Boil the rice in water until soft.
Add the low-fat milk and simmer, stirring.
Add the mashed dates or honey and vanilla after taking it off the heat.
Serve warm or cold with cinnamon and nuts.

what_changed: Low-fat milk instead of whole milk
A small amount of natural sweetener instead of sugar
Cinnamon for extra flavor without sugar
tips: Serve in small cups
Add the sweetness after cooking so you need less
